top_signals.title: CFTC Takes Oil Trading Oversight ‘Very Seriously,’ Selig Says
top_signals.summary: The top US derivatives regulator said Friday that his agency takes market oversight “very seriously” and the agency’s enforcement division has been looking at oil trading during the Iran war.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Decker Outdoor Tumbles on Guidance; Amex to Cut Workforce | Stock Movers
top_signals.summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Decker Outdoor (DECK) is tumbling after the footwear company cut its net sales guidance for the full year, which also fell short of the consensus estimate. 
- Kering (KER) shares are slumping after the French luxury-goods company saw further deceleration of third-quarter revenue growth at its key Gucci unit, slower growth in North America as well as persistent weakness in China. 
- American Express (AXP) shares are moving on news that the company is planning to cut 5% of its global headcount. Chief Executive Officer Steve Squeri told Bloomberg TV that the move will affect about 3,500 jobs.
- Moderna (MRNA) plummeted after data on the companies’ widely anticipated melanoma vaccine wasn’t enough to prove to investors that a new era of cancer treatments has arrived. While the results clearly showed the vaccine worked, they weren’t spectacular enough to generate confidence. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: India’s RBI Governor Open to Rate Use to Curb Financial Risks
top_signals.summary: India’s central bank can deploy interest rates to address financial-stability risks, if needed, said Governor Sanjay Malhotra, in comments that come when analysts expect further pressure on the rupee.
